1. The fraction 5/8 expressed as a decimal is ______ (2 marks)

6. The value of π (pi) to 2 decimal places is ______ (2 marks)
7. Write five thousand and seven in figures: ______ (2 marks)

17. Find the range: 12, 8, 15, 3. (2 marks)
18. If 3x – 4 = 11, find the value of x. (3 marks)
